{"subject":"Throughput per node for Cassandra-style workloads","body":"Hi Dana,

Congrats on your recent move to Brightwave AI. I saw that Northwind Payments, your previous company, runs fraud scoring on Astra DB, a workload you may have seen up close.

I'm Oz, GTM Engineer at ScyllaDB. ScyllaDB delivers higher throughput per node, which typically means fewer nodes and lower infrastructure cost for the same workload.

If Cassandra-compatible storage comes up as you shape infrastructure at Brightwave AI, would you be open to comparing notes sometime?

Reply STOP to opt out.","evidence_ids":["champ_p12_a01"],"value_prop_ids":["vp_tco"],"context_fact_ids":[]}
